title: Developmental Pediatrics
shortDescription: Comprehensive assessment of growth, learning, and behavior.
fullDescription: We evaluate developmental milestones and design individualized care plans to support communication, learning, and emotional development.

title: Speech Therapy
shortDescription: Improving speech clarity, language, and social communication.
fullDescription: Our speech-language therapists help children strengthen expressive and receptive language, articulation, and functional communication in daily life.

title: Occupational Therapy
shortDescription: Support for sensory, motor, and daily living skills.
fullDescription: We work on fine motor control, sensory integration, and self-care routines that improve confidence at home and school.

title: Physiotherapy
shortDescription: Strength, posture, mobility, and movement training.
fullDescription: Therapy sessions focus on gross motor skills, balance, gait, and muscle coordination for children with developmental or neuromotor challenges.

title: Behavior Therapy
shortDescription: Structured behavior plans for positive outcomes.
fullDescription: Using child-friendly methods, we address behavior concerns, improve attention, and build adaptive skills through consistent reinforcement strategies.

title: Special Education
shortDescription: Personalized learning support and academic readiness.
fullDescription: Our educators tailor instruction to each child, focusing on foundational literacy, numeracy, and classroom participation skills.

title: Early Intervention
shortDescription: Therapy and coaching for children 0-6 years.
fullDescription: Early, targeted support helps children build critical developmental abilities during the most responsive years of brain growth.

title: Diagnostic Screening
fullDescription: We perform screening and profile-based evaluations to identify strengths, risks, and intervention priorities accurately.

title: Parent Counselling
shortDescription: Practical strategies for home and routine management.
fullDescription: We guide parents with actionable tools to support communication, regulation, and learning through everyday interactions.

title: School Readiness Program
shortDescription: Building skills for successful classroom transitions.
fullDescription: Children develop attention, pre-academics, peer interaction, and independence skills needed for school settings.

title: Group Therapy
shortDescription: Peer-based sessions for social and communication growth.
fullDescription: Small-group activities help children practice turn-taking, collaboration, and emotional regulation in guided social contexts.

title: Neurology Follow-up
shortDescription: Ongoing review for neurological developmental concerns.
fullDescription: Regular follow-ups track developmental progress, response to interventions, and evolving clinical recommendations.

title: Comprehensive Care Planning
shortDescription: Integrated plans across therapies and specialists.
fullDescription: Our multidisciplinary team aligns goals, timelines, and home programs so children receive coordinated, measurable support.
